findings.subject: organization
findings.rationale: Claim A asserts that an organization must review and update audited events at a defined frequency, presenting this as an active requirement. Claim B states that the specific control enhancement addressing this requirement (AU-2(3)) has been withdrawn and incorporated into the base control AU-2. These statements conflict because Claim A treats the review/update requirement as a standalone obligation, while Claim B indicates this enhancement has been superseded and merged into a different control structure.
findings.resolution_hint: Claim B represents the current state (withdrawal and incorporation), making it the authoritative version; Claim A may reflect an outdated control structure.

near_duplicates.subject: AU-2
near_duplicates.rationale: Claim A states that AU-2(3) EVENT LOGGING | REVIEWS AND UPDATES has been withdrawn and incorporated into AU-2. Claim B asserts that AU-2(3) is currently assigned to the MODERATE and HIGH baselines as an active enhancement. These claims cannot both be true if AU-2(3) has been withdrawn; a withdrawn control cannot simultaneously be assigned to active baselines.
near_duplicates.resolution_hint: Claim A represents the current state (withdrawal); Claim B may reflect an outdated or superseded baseline assignment.
